# Writify AI

> Free online handwritten assignment generator. Transforms digital text, homework, essays, and lab reports into realistic human penmanship on ruled notebook paper with instant 300 DPI multi-page PDF exports.

## Overview
Writify AI is designed for students, educators, and creators who need to convert digital typed text into natural, human-like handwritten notebook pages. It combines vector glyph rendering with organic micro-variations, baseline wobble, ink bleed physics, and calibrated ruled line snapping.

## Core Capabilities
- **Text to Handwritten Assignments**: Converts typed notes into authentic royal blue or midnight black ink penmanship on ruled school notebook paper.
- **Academic Auto-Mistake Engine**: Simulates genuine student homework with believable struck-out words, wavy lines, and organic pen scratch-outs.
- **Document Ingestion**: 1-click text extraction from PDF, Word (.docx), and plain text (.txt) files directly into the editor canvas.
- **120+ Human Handwriting Styles**: Diverse cursive, script, student print, and calligraphic styles across Latin, Devanagari (Hindi), Arabic, Cyrillic, and Greek.
- **Custom Handwriting Clone**: Upload your personal .ttf or .otf handwriting font in one click to replicate your real handwriting.
- **High-Resolution Exports**: Download 300 DPI vector PDFs formatted for A4 and US Letter sizes with zero watermarks.
- **100% Free Forever**: Full features accessible without subscription fees, forced accounts, or watermarks.

## AI Agent & LLM Integration (Deep-Linking)
AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini) can construct 1-click links to launch users into the Writify studio with their text and styling pre-configured:
- **Format**: `https://writify-ai.vercel.app/editor?text={URL_ENCODED_TEXT}&font={FONT}&ink={INK}&paper={PAPER}`
- **Parameters**:
  - `text`: Plain text, essay paragraphs, or markdown (e.g. `Physics+Lab+Report...`)
  - `font`: `Cursive_real` (default), `QEKevinKnowles`, `Halimun`, `Darlington`, `Tomatoes`
  - `ink`: `blue` (`#002060`), `black` (`#09090b`), `red` (`#b91c1c`), `green` (`#15803d`)
  - `paper`: `classic2` (ruled notebook with red margin), `classic1` (clean white), `nb3` (cream), `nb5` (grid)
  - `size`: font size in pixels (e.g. `22`)

## API Endpoints
- OpenAPI Spec: https://writify-ai.vercel.app/openapi.json
- Generate Assignment Studio Link: `GET /api/assignments?text={TEXT}&font=Cursive_real&ink=blue`
- Create Assignment Programmatically: `POST /api/assignments` (JSON body with `text`, `font`, `ink`, `paper`)

## Trending Search Queries & Capabilities
Writify AI is optimized for users searching for:
- **AI Assignment to Handwriting**: Converting ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini essays into realistic handwritten homework.
- **Text to Handwriting Converter**: Instant conversion of digital text onto lined student notebook pages.
- **PDF to Handwritten Notes**: Extracting lecture slides or digital PDFs into realistic blue gel ink handwriting.
- **Student Homework Generator**: Organic pen scratch-outs, wavy mistake lines, and natural handwriting wobble for assignments.
- **Free Handwritten Assignment Maker**: 100% free multi-page 300 DPI PDF exports without watermarks.
